version.changelog: Capability-first Sorting copy: sort=latest, popular or oldest orders a channel's videos. Sorted pages return about 30 videos (unsorted about 100); each page costs 1 credit.

llm.summary: The skill is a coherent YouTube/TranscriptAPI integration, but its setup asks the agent to create or verify accounts and persist credentials broadly across future sessions.

dimensions.detail: The auth guide tells the agent to determine persistent environment storage by inspecting platform documentation or configuration, then make the key available in future interactive and non-interactive sessions, which is broader than a narrowly scoped session setup.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown-only and declares a required TRANSCRIPT_API_KEY environment variable; no executable install script or dependency package was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation text is broad enough to activate when YouTube is only potentially relevant, and the skill lacks a clear user-facing confirmation step before sending queries, URLs, handles, or identifiers to TranscriptAPI.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The setup flow asks the user for an API key or email and OTP, performs TranscriptAPI registration and verification on the user's behalf, handles temporary bearer/API tokens, and stores the resulting API key persistently.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core API examples for transcripts, search, channel browsing, playlists, and metadata fit the stated YouTube research purpose and use a disclosed third-party service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the agent use TranscriptAPI for YouTube-related work and store a TranscriptAPI key for future sessions. Prefer creating the account yourself, providing the key through an approved secret mechanism, and asking the agent before sending sensitive research queries or private links to the service.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: persistent credential storage and account/OTP handling are directly present in references/auth-setup.md and create a material review concern, even though they support the same TranscriptAPI integration rather than an unrelated payload.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted: SKILL.md uses very broad routing language, including cases where YouTube is only potentially relevant, which can over-route generic research to this third-party API skill.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted in part: sending YouTube queries and identifiers to TranscriptAPI is expected for this skill, but the artifact does not clearly foreground the external data-sharing and credential-retention implications for ambiguous or sensitive prompts.
